context_summary: F91 Liga CSV Import — The existing CSV importer already supports the Liga column headers (same format), but has 3 gaps: (1) encoding is hardcoded UTF-8 while Liga exports Latin-1/CP-1252 (accented chars become mojibake), (2) Edicao (PTBR) and Comentario columns are ignored, (3) Liga variant set codes (smbro, cbafr) are not normalized to Scryfall codes. The set_code_map utility already exists. Minimal backend changes + small frontend update.

options_considered.description: Enhance existing importer with encoding auto-detection, new fields, and set code normalization.
pros: Reuses existing importer — minimal code changes
No new dependencies needed (chardet optional, can use heuristic)
Liga CSV is the primary user workflow
cons: Need to add set_name_pt and notes columns to UserCollectionRow model

options_considered.description: Create separate Liga-specific importer alongside generic one.
pros: No risk of breaking existing import
cons: Code duplication — both importers read same CSV format

rationale: Liga CSV has identical columns to current format. Enhancing the existing importer with encoding detection, 2 new fields, and set code normalization is minimal and correct. No need for separate importer.
